verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs explicitly state users can 'issue safes or convertible notes' with customizable key terms via templated forms (clerky-docs-9, clerky-docs-11, clerky-docs-20), and community reviews corroborate a smooth, standardized document-generation experience (clerky-comm-2, clerky-comm-12). This directly matches the founder story of generating/signing SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically walking through the SAFE/convertible note signing flow, and no detail on e-signature mechanics for these specific documents.
